hook_en: He can calm your storm to a whisper. 🙏
reflect_en: When they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, He brought them out of their distress and guided them to the harbor they desired. Whatever is churning in you this midweek, you can call on Him and trust Him to bring you safely through.
q_en: What storm do you need God to calm this week?
x_en: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
tiktok: For the storm you're in right now 🙏 Psalm 107:29 — He calmed the storm to a whisper
yt_title: He Calmed the Storm to a Whisper | Psalm 107:28–31 #Shorts
li_open: Every team hits rough water sooner or later.
li_quote: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress. He calmed the storm to a whisper
li_body: The people in this psalm didn't steer their own way out; they cried out to the LORD, and He guided them to the harbor they desired. When a church, ministry or team is in a hard season, making space to pray together and to carry one another's requests keeps people steady until the waves are hushed.
reflect_es: Clamaron a Jehová en su angustia, y Él hizo parar la tempestad en sosiego y los guió al puerto que deseaban. Sea lo que sea que te agite a mitad de esta semana, puedes clamar a Él y confiar en que te llevará a buen puerto.
q_es: ¿Qué tempestad necesitas que Dios calme esta semana?
x_es: Hace parar la tempestad en sosiego, y se apaciguan sus ondas.
key_en: He calmed the storm to a whisper
key_es: Hace parar la tempestad en sosiego
